reviewer.display_name: AI-assisted translation and adversarial preflight (not a human reviewer)

findings.explanation: Hầu gái weakens the Brazilian historical specificity of mucamas. Dictionary evidence and the competing renderings nữ tỳ / hầu gái need a qualified literary historian’s choice or annotation.
Ông giáo dạy môn u sầu preserves the joke but may over-literalize professor de melancolia as a curriculum. Test against bậc thầy về nỗi u sầu without losing the mock-academic voice.
The four plic beats are retained exactly; a Vietnamese read-aloud test is still needed to decide if a local sound-word is preferable.

The dangling Vietnamese subject could make the needle obey itself; the source explicitly makes the following thread the obedient subject. The recorded draft rendering was revised after an additional AI-assisted adversarial reading.

summary: AI-assisted direct Portuguese-to-Vietnamese draft and adversarial preflight only. All 22 canonical paragraph/dialogue units are covered. The review checked the needle/pin head pun, status reversal, repeated sewing actions, narrator’s Diana interruption, four-day chronology and final thread insult. Historical mucamas, the mock title professor de melancolia, and the sound-word need bilingual human judgment. The 8.55 advisory score is a subjective preflight, not an independent calibration or publication approval; no human reviewers or permissions are claimed. An additional AI-assisted read corrected 1 documented local fidelity issues without changing the advisory score.
